status: Candidate scope and contact targets sent; no delivered or accepted mesh
production_instruction: Codex requested a separate first civilian candidate under Felix’s autonomous vertical-slice brief. Blenderbot acknowledged the contact requirements but reported its direct production question to Felix still pending; production has not been confirmed started.

scope.role: One original clothed adult civilian, separate from accepted officer sources
scope.transitions: Connecting stand/kneel/restraint/start/stop transitions with exact timestamps, interpolation, support/contact phases and root-motion declarations
scope.unsupported_states: Keep existing fallbacks until separately delivered and qualified, including stunned/fallen/fleeing/low-clearance escort states.

coordinates.source_front: Explicitly declare source front/root/floor/sole convention and exact source-to-engine transform

controller_references.policy: Report anatomical/animation mismatch against these existing controller references. Do not silently scale or distort anatomy to fit. They are engine targets, not verified source-anatomical eye locations.

restraint.pose: Wrists behind the back; relaxed parallel forearms, palms outward, thumbs upward; preserve natural shoulder and wrist bends
restraint.cuff_fit: Fit openings/bands to the actual authored wrists. Report actual inner/outer envelopes, spacing, endpoint transforms and connector length; flag conflicts with provisional targets.

markers.x_axis: Toward fingers along the distal forearm
markers.mapping: Declare actual exported rest/contact transforms separately from native joint frames and preserve the original rest/bind/skin mapping.

interaction_reference.policy: Declare natural transition and contact timing independently; presentation must adapt to a reported mismatch rather than force a rushed animation.

escort.requirements: Wrists/cuffs stay coherent through restrained stand and escort walk; standing remains conditional on achieved controller clearance.

delivery.runtime: Neutral dense GLB with explicit actual node/joint/rest/inverse-bind/skin mapping and all original weights
delivery.maps: Separate original maps plus exact glTF material/texture bindings, normal/tangent conventions and provenance
delivery.source: Editable original source and reproducible export instructions

current_consumer_limits.policy: Report actual candidate counts. Validate or extend consumer limits at integration; do not prune weights, discard meshes or imply that the officer72-joint variant is universal.
